1 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.OctahedralFanDevelopment
2 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.OctahedralPetalPlacement
3 
4 /-! One coherent four-triangle fan with its four outward petals, at any source and slit. -/
5 
6 namespace SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron.SixVertexGraph
7 
8 open OctahedralTriangles
9 
10 variable {P : ConvexPolyhedron} (graph : P.SixVertexGraph)
11 variable (small_faces : ∀ F : P.Face, (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 3 ∨
12   (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 4)
13 
14 /-- The eight developed triangles share the chosen fan opening and four outward equator hinges.
15 Whole-facet consistency across auxiliary hinges is a later reassembly obligation. -/
16 structure Development (source : Fin 6) (slit : Fin 4) where
17   fan : graph.FanDevelopment small_faces (opposite source) slit
18   patch : ∀ i : Fin 4, graph.DevelopedPatch source (slit + i)
19   patch_pole : ∀ i, (patch i).pole = 0
20   patch_left : ∀ i, (patch i).left = graph.openingPoint (opposite source) slit i.castSucc
21   patch_right : ∀ i, (patch i).right = graph.openingPoint (opposite source) slit i.succ
22   petal : Fin 4 → Space →ᵃ[ℝ] Plane
23   petal_left : ∀ i, petal i (graph.vertex (fanNeighbor source (slit + i))) = (patch i).left
24   petal_right : ∀ i, petal i (graph.vertex (fanNeighbor source ((slit + i) + 1))) = (patch i).right
25   petal_apex : ∀ i, petal i (graph.vertex source) = (patch i).apex
26   petal_rigid : ∀ i, ∀ x ∈ (graph.triangleFace small_faces (fanTriangle source (slit + i))).val,
27     ∀ y ∈ (graph.triangleFace small_faces (fanTriangle source (slit + i))).val,
28       dist (petal i x) (petal i y) = dist x y
29 
30 /-- Every source and every slit admit this simultaneous outward development. -/
31 theorem exists_development (source : Fin 6) (slit : Fin 4) : Nonempty (graph.Development small_faces source slit) := by
32   classical
33   obtain ⟨fan⟩ := graph.exists_fan_development small_faces (opposite source) slit
34   have patches : ∀ i : Fin 4, ∃ patch : graph.DevelopedPatch source (slit + i),
35       patch.pole = 0 ∧ patch.left = graph.openingPoint (opposite source) slit i.castSucc ∧
36       patch.right = graph.openingPoint (opposite source) slit i.succ := by
37     intro i
38     obtain ⟨patch, pole, left, right⟩ := graph.exists_patch_of_fan_placement small_faces source (slit + i)
39       (fan.place i) (fan.rigid i)
40     have paired : ∀ s j, fanNeighbor (opposite s) j = fanNeighbor s j := by decide
41     refine ⟨patch, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
42     · rw [pole, fan.at_pole]
43     · rw [left, ← paired source (slit + i), fan.at_left]
44     · rw [right, ← paired source ((slit + i) + 1), fan.at_right]
45   choose patch patch_pole patch_left patch_right using patches
46   choose petal petal_left petal_right petal_apex petal_rigid using
47     fun i => (patch i).exists_petal_placement small_faces
48   exact ⟨⟨fan, patch, patch_pole, patch_left, patch_right, petal, petal_left, petal_right, petal_apex, petal_rigid⟩⟩
49 
50 namespace Development
51 
52 variable {graph small_faces} {source : Fin 6} {slit : Fin 4}
53 variable (net : graph.Development small_faces source slit)
54 
55 /-- The actual fan triangle has the three corners recorded by its patch. -/
56 theorem fan_triangle (i : Fin 4) :
57     net.fan.place i '' graph.triangle (fanTriangle (opposite source) (slit + i)) =
58       convexHull ℝ ({(net.patch i).pole, (net.patch i).left, (net.patch i).right} : Set Plane) := by
59   rw [net.fan.placed_triangle, net.patch_pole, net.patch_left, net.patch_right]
60   rfl
61 
62 /-- The actual petal has exactly its copied apex and the two common hinge endpoints. -/
63 theorem petal_triangle (i : Fin 4) :
64     net.petal i '' graph.triangle (fanTriangle source (slit + i)) =
65       convexHull ℝ ({(net.patch i).apex, (net.patch i).left, (net.patch i).right} : Set Plane) := by
66   rw [triangle, fanTriangle_vertices, graph.labeledHull_triple, (net.petal i).image_convexHull,
67     Set.image_insert_eq, Set.image_insert_eq, Set.image_singleton,
68     net.petal_apex, net.petal_left, net.petal_right]
69 
70 /-- Every petal is disjoint in interior from the fan triangle carrying it. -/
71 theorem attached_pair_nonoverlap (i : Fin 4) :
72     Disjoint (interior (net.fan.place i '' graph.triangle (fanTriangle (opposite source) (slit + i))))
73       (interior (net.petal i '' graph.triangle (fanTriangle source (slit + i)))) := by
74   rw [net.fan_triangle, net.petal_triangle]
75   have reorder (x a b : Plane) : ({x, a, b} : Set Plane) = {a, b, x} := by
76     ext z
77     simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
78     tauto
79   rw [reorder (net.patch i).pole, reorder (net.patch i).apex]
80   exact opposite_triangles_disjoint _ _ _ _ (net.patch i).fan_noncollinear (net.patch i).outward
81 
82 /-- The petal and its fan triangle agree on the entire equator hinge. -/
83 theorem petal_joined (i : Fin 4) :
84     ∀ x ∈ segment ℝ (graph.vertex (fanNeighbor source (slit + i)) : Space)
85       (graph.vertex (fanNeighbor source ((slit + i) + 1))), net.fan.place i x = net.petal i x := by
86   have paired : ∀ s j, fanNeighbor (opposite s) j = fanNeighbor s j := by decide
87   have agree : Set.EqOn (net.fan.place i) (net.petal i)
88       ({(graph.vertex (fanNeighbor source (slit + i)) : Space),
89         (graph.vertex (fanNeighbor source ((slit + i) + 1)) : Space)} : Set Space) := by
90     rintro x (rfl | rfl)
91     · rw [net.petal_left, net.patch_left, ← paired source (slit + i), net.fan.at_left]
92     · rw [net.petal_right, net.patch_right, ← paired source ((slit + i) + 1), net.fan.at_right]
93   intro x member
94   apply AffineMap.eqOn_affineSpan agree
95   rw [← convexHull_pair] at member
96   exact convexHull_subset_affineSpan _ member
97 
98 end Development
99 end SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron.SixVertexGraph
